headline: Itaú BBA lowers Brazil 2027 GDP growth forecast to 0.5%
summary: Itaú BBA revised its 2027 GDP growth forecast for Brazil down to 0.5% from 1.2%, citing higher inflation and sustained high interest rates.
why: Major bank revisions to GDP forecasts influence investor sentiment and capital allocation within the country.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Downward revisions to growth forecasts typically dampen investor confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market participants react to reduced growth expectations by adjusting their outlook on corporate earnings and sovereign risk.
